changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.03[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Dolby Vision profile 8.1[/COLOR]
-Dolby Vision profile 8.1 is now read from the release name and shown as DV-P8.1 (and HLG as DV-P8.4). Before, it showed as DV-P8.
-More ways of writing it are recognised, such as DV P8.1, DoVi P8.1, DV.Profile.8.1, Dolby Vision 8.1, P81, DV8.1 and DVP8.1. A name with profile 8 and HDR10 is shown as 8.1.
-Profile 8.1 always has an HDR10 base, so it counts as HDR: Remove Dolby Vision sources no longer hides files that play as HDR10.
-Fixed: audio channels next to the mark were taken for a profile (DV P8 2.0, AAC.P5.1).
[COLOR fffdb515]Real data from the file, read before playback[/COLOR]
-From the same header it already reads for the audio tracks, the audio probe now also reads the real Dolby Vision profile and the real duration of the file. No extra request.
-Real average bitrate: the exact file size divided by the real duration. The pre-flight slow-link check uses it instead of the estimate from the scraper size and the TMDb runtime. When the header has no duration, the estimate is used as before.
-What the file says wins over the name: the real profile, FEL and MEL only with an enhancement layer, no HDR on profile 5 and no SDR on Dolby Vision.
-Bitrate per track (video and each audio track): exact for MP4 and, for MKV made with mkvmerge, read in the background once playback has started. Short peaks are not warned about.
-The playback notification and the autoplay window show it under In this file, for example CAST · EN | DV-P8.1 | 58 Mbps average. Once a release has been played, its row in the source list shows the real profile and bitrate in bold.
-Setting renamed: Read the real audio tracks, Dolby Vision profile and bitrate before playback.
[COLOR fffdb515]Kodi 22[/COLOR]
-On Kodi 22, while a video plays, the add-on samples Kodi's live video bitrate, audio bitrate and decoder queue, leaving out pauses, buffering and seeks, and logs them at the end next to what the probe read. On Kodi 21 this part does not start and everything else works the same.
[COLOR fffdb515]Continue Watching[/COLOR]
-Continue Watching cards show how many aired episodes are left, next to the show's name so it is never cut off: Dark Matter • 3 left - 2x05 . Love and Be Loved. When the next episode has not aired yet: Up to date.
-It is part of the card's text, so it shows on any skin, in the in-progress and next-episode lists of Trakt, SIMKL, MDBList, PunchPlay and WeTrakr.
-Counted from TMDb data the add-on already keeps, without specials or announced episodes. Nothing is shown when TMDb's numbering does not match the service. The title sent to playback and scrobbling stays clean.
-New setting in TV Shows, on by default: Continue Watching: show how many aired episodes are left.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-Trakt progress lists and managers no longer fail on a new install before the first sync, or when Trakt does not answer. Hidden Progress Manager no longer leaves the busy indicator on screen, and the progress managers say Nothing Was Found instead of opening empty.
-Trakt popular and trending lists open empty, without errors, when Trakt does not answer.
-The debrid account status file read by companion tools (debrid_state.json) is written again. It holds no tokens.
-AllDebrid: Transfers and the cloud folders show their items again. Every item was being dropped, so both lists came up empty.
-Title substitutions: adding a new one asks for both titles again instead of failing.
-IMDb lists open empty, without errors, when IMDb does not answer.
